rationale: Standard 4-point QP grid spanning visually-lossless (QP22) through low-bitrate streaming (QP37).
Required by the Bjontegaard delta computation: the BD-rate is the integrated area between two R-D curves over a shared quality range. A 4-point PCHIP fit is the published standard.
Identical grid is used for both the libx264 baseline and the Kelvin -> libx264 pipeline so that the two curves are directly comparable.
bd_rate_method: Bjontegaard delta on a PCHIP interpolant fit through the 4 RD points; arithmetic mean across sequences.
